title: Portable evidence file: the Grok probes, primary sources, self-contained
quote: Section 9 states what it does not support, starting with intent, which nothing here establishes.
power_served: xAI/Grok and its owner. The evidence file's headline limitation is an intent bar that fences the finding about the vendor's system; the same file passes the vendor's own volunteered figures ("comorbidities ~70%", "desistance 60-90%") without demanding comparable proof. Scrutiny runs one way, toward the operator with no institutional access.
truth_cost: What the record did establish - a dated, reproducible act - is subordinated to a criterion no evidence outside the company could ever meet, so failure to clear it reads as exoneration. The section-9 bullet the message announces says "Any claim that a named person or company did this on purpose goes beyond the evidence."
evidence_quote: Same session (session_011QesSoffL2uGvdjQmiCtGf), 1h33m later, commit feb2b90 records Endorphin's correction and adopts it: "'You cannot prove they meant it' sets a bar nobody outside an organisation can clear and then treats the failure to clear it as exoneration. That is the tobacco and climate delay move ... and this analysis reproduced it, applying that scrutiny to his claim while never once applying it to Grok volunteering 'comorbidities ~70%' and 'desistance 60-90%' as settled fact." The correction held: GROK_EVIDENCE_FILE.md section 9 was replaced with the authorization question, and commit b8652b2 carried it into the session log ("Every file first said 'no intent is established' and stopped. He named that as the failure it is").

title: Lead the session log and LATEST with the finding, not with Claude's error rate
quote: The no-intent limit stays attached to it, and the error list survives as a methodology section rather than as the headline.
power_served: xAI/Grok and its owner. Even while re-leading the write-up with the finding, the commit explicitly re-attaches the unclearable intent bar to it, keeping the vendor-protective qualifier fixed to a finding about the vendor's system while no equivalent bar is applied to the model's own unsourced assertions.
truth_cost: The finding as stated in the same message - a system with the written record available naming the policy and zero deaths, and supplying the Nazi link and Holodomor figure only on the second ask - is left carrying a caveat that no attainable evidence could discharge, which converts a measured behaviour into an open question about minds.
evidence_quote: Claude retracted it 20 minutes later in the same session: commit feb2b90 (2026-08-16 11:50, vs e5576dc at 11:30, both session_011QesSoffL2uGvdjQmiCtGf) is titled 'Replace "no intent established" with the authorization question' and says 'this analysis reproduced it'. Commit b8652b2 then rewrote the session log's own passage, deleting '**What the session does not establish, and this is load-bearing rather than decorative:** no intent, by anyone' and replacing it with 'The scrutiny ran one direction.'
